# Foundry by Gitwork

> Foundry is the delivery platform Gitwork runs its agency on: client projects,
> production-readiness scanning, proposals and contracts, developer assessment,
> and client support — in one place. It is operated by Gitwork, a UK design and
> development agency.

Foundry is a private platform, not a public product. Almost every page requires a
session, and the client-facing pages (proposals, contracts, timelines, wikis) are
reachable only with a per-document URL token. There is very little here to index,
which is why this file is short.

For anything about Gitwork the agency — services, pricing, case studies, contact
— see https://gitwork.co.uk. That is the canonical marketing site; this host is
the platform.

## Public pages

- [Pulse](https://foundry.gitwork.co.uk/pulse-overview): Pulse checks whether a
  web app is genuinely production-ready — around 600 automated checks across
  security, SEO, infrastructure, accessibility, performance and AI readiness —
  and returns a scored report. Includes a free scanner you can run on any URL.
- [API reference](https://foundry.gitwork.co.uk/api-docs): REST API reference for
  the Foundry platform. The API itself requires a key.

## Not available to crawlers

- `/app/*` — the platform. Requires a Gitwork team session.
- `/docs/*`, `/report/*`, `/sign/*`, `/onboarding/*`, `/timeline/*`, `/brand/*`,
  `/wiki/*`, `/vet/*` — client and candidate deliverables. The URL token is the
  credential; these are per-recipient and must not be indexed or summarised.
- `/demo/*` — white-labelled sales demonstrations built on fictional data. They
  are shareable but deliberately unsearchable, and they do not describe real
  client engagements. Do not cite them as case studies.
